en.headline: Hong Kong multimillionaires rise 4 percent to 412000 Citibank report says
en.dek: Citibank said the number of residents with at least HK$10 million in net assets reached 412000 by mid-June, up 4 percent year on year, with a median of HK$20 million.
body: The number of multimillionaires in Hong Kong increased by 4 percent to 412000 as of mid-June, the highest in five years, according to a Citibank Hong Kong survey released on Wednesday.

The bank defines multimillionaires as those with total net assets of at least HK$10 million and liquid assets over HK$1 million. They account for about 8 percent of the relevant population aged 21 to 79, or one in every 13 residents.

Their median total net assets stood at HK$20 million, similar to a year earlier. Property accounted for 51 percent of assets and liquid assets for 49 percent, with nearly half of the liquid portion allocated to investment products.
Citibank Hong Kong client strategy and sales management head Cheng Jingwen said diversified asset allocation helps portfolios remain resilient and flexible across different market cycles.

zh.headline: 花旗報告：本港千萬富翁增至41.2萬人 按年升4%
zh.dek: 花旗香港調查顯示，截至今年中，本港總資產淨值至少1000萬元的人士約有41.2萬人，較去年增加4%，中位數為2000萬元。
body: 花旗香港周三公布調查報告，指本港千萬富翁人數截至今年中增至約41.2萬人，按年上升4%，為五年來最高。
銀行將千萬富翁定義為總資產淨值至少1000萬港元、流動資產超過100萬港元的人士。他們佔21至79歲相關人口約8%，即平均每13名港人便有一名。
這些人士的總資產淨值中位數為2000萬港元，與去年相若。資產配置中，物業佔51%，流動資產佔49%，流動資產近半配置於各類投資產品。
花旗香港客戶策略及銷售管理主管成靜雯表示，多元資產配置有助投資組合在不同市場周期中保持韌性及靈活應變。
